notes:
Every visualization now exports a **PNG** alongside HTML and PDF — the whole diagram at full size, for slides and documents that won't place a PDF. The **Treemap** is recolorable: open the Legend to change a whole category, or right-click a single box to call it out in a client deck, and your palette saves with the project. The Treemap and Content Flow can now be **exported to Miro** the way the Visual Sitemap already could.

**Consolidate** gained guardrails: a page can no longer consolidate into itself (or into a page that consolidates back into it), choosing a target marked Keep or Kill now offers to set it to Evolve, and a chip in the sidebar shows how many Consolidate pages still have no target — usually more than you'd expect.

Fixed: exporting the Content Flow gave you the view it opened with rather than the one on screen, so a PDF could show a completely different reading than the one you meant to hand over.
